id.description: The unique identifier for the approval

approvalDefinitionId.description: The id of the approval definition associated with this approval

entityId.description: The id of the approval entity, such as the id of the offer version

entityType.description: The type of entity associated with this approval

createdAt.description: The date and time when the approval was created

steps.description: The approval steps for this approval

id.description: The unique identifier for the approval step

approvalsRequired.description: The number of approvers required to approve this step before the approval moves to the next step

approvers.description: An unordered list of users who can approve this step

id.description: The unique identifier for the approval step approver

userId.description: The id of a user who is an approver for this step

decision.description: The approver's decision for this approval step
